file audit: tracked files, missing seed.sql/tests/README/scripts

scope: Automated proof of the RLS and broadcast-topic model (16 goals) against the local Supabase stack, in database-thinkboard-lite/supabase/tests/. Out of scope: changing a policy to make a test pass (a red test is a finding for 001 — stop and show the owner), seed data (003), the live topic (015), any product code.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test fixture creates the three profiles and one workspace from scratch.
B's insert is an RLS denial; the leader's succeeds.
B's subscribed client sees exactly one event, for the promoted row.
Both rows change in one call; B's call on A's highlight raises.
All four queries as B return 0 rows.
Denial, success, success — in that order.
B's client gets RETRACT; A's second client gets UPDATE on user:{A}.
Nothing arrives for B; B's select returns 0 rows.
Routing matches the highlight's visibility in both cases.
Every write by B on a group run's children, and B's delete of the group run, changes no row or is denied; the leader's and A's-own-run writes succeed.
B's inserts (group, initial) are RLS denials; the leader's both succeed; B still reads group memory.
Caller is leader after create_workspace; the two refusals raise; after a valid transfer exactly one leader exists and it is the target.

open_questions: D-01 (defaulted: individual is a privacy boundary) — g2, g3, g8 are its proof.
D-03 (defaulted: group result is leader-only) — g9.
DB-Q7 (defaulted: member group-visibility notes allowed as written) — g11 pins today's behaviour.
DB-Q10 (confirmed: 0001 had no write policy; leader writes memory) — g15.
D-09 (defaulted) — g16 tests the leader path only.
NEW: @supabase/supabase-js devDependency for the realtime tests — not answered by the owner; defaulted to no dependency (see code.json.decisions).
risks: A realtime assertion that passes because the client never subscribed. Assert the positive case (g5's promoted row) in the same test as the negative one.
Testing as the postgres role bypasses RLS entirely. Every query must run under a signed-in user's JWT.
setAuth() before subscribe (I22) applies to the test clients too, or g5/g10/g12 silently receive nothing.
Harness: no pg_prove image is cached, so `supabase test db` would download one. SQL tests therefore run as plain SQL through `docker exec psql`; each test is one transaction that rolls back.
Seeding runs as postgres because clients cannot add team members (the gap raised for task 008). Each test then sets `role authenticated` and asserts current_user, so RLS is really in force.
Realtime tests need two real signed-in sessions: users sign up through GoTrue with the publishable key (sign-up on, confirmations off), so no secret key is used.
'Nothing arrives' needs a wait window; it is one named constant, and every negative case also asserts a positive event on the same connection.
database-thinkboard-lite/ has no README/CLAUDE.md, no package.json scripts and no seed.sql — the seed.sql absence means `db reset` runs with seeding enabled but no file.
